sentence: A group pizza order card where people vote on toppings, vote for two or three pies, and one person volunteers to pay, with the per-person cost shown after a discount code.
use_when: a group chat needs to pick pizza toppings for a shared meal
people want to decide how many pies to order
someone needs to volunteer to pay and see the split cost
a group needs a quick food order sorted out
dont_use_when: a general poll with custom questions and options is needed
splitting a bill with different amounts per person
ordering from a menu with many different items or sizes
